details: Tensions between the US and Iran have escalated significantly as Iran once again closed the Strait of Hormuz to tanker traffic after a brief reopening. This move followed a US claim of seizing an Iranian cargo ship, which Iran has condemned as "armed piracy" and vowed retaliation. Negotiations between the two nations are ongoing, but substantial disagreements remain over Iran's nuclear program and the US naval blockade of Iranian ports. Oil prices reacted sharply to the developments, with Brent crude futures climbing by 4.9% to $94.77 a barrel and U.S. West Texas Intermediate crude futures increasing by 5.8% to $87.33 a barrel on Monday.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate as Hormuz Closes, Driving Oil Price Swings

details: The United States and Iran are reportedly preparing for a new round of peace talks in Pakistan this week, ahead of the expiration of a two-week ceasefire. Despite these diplomatic efforts, deep divisions persist, particularly regarding Iran's nuclear ambitions and the ongoing US naval blockade. Iran's foreign minister has characterized the US's "continued violations of the ceasefire" as a significant impediment to the diplomatic process. US President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning, stating that "lots of bombs" will be deployed if a resolution is not achieved by the ceasefire's deadline.
title: US and Iran Plan New Talks Amid Standoff Over Hormuz and Nuclear Program

details: Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's newly appointed Supreme Leader, is reportedly still recuperating from severe facial and leg injuries sustained during an airstrike that killed his father. Although he has not made a public appearance since his appointment on March 8, sources indicate he remains mentally capable. However, his relative inexperience and injuries are thought to potentially limit his immediate absolute power, with the Revolutionary Guard possibly exerting a more dominant influence. Khamenei has, nonetheless, issued statements vowing retaliation against Iran's adversaries.
title: Iran's New Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei Recovering from Injuries, Influence Debated
